propositions: Pre-existing fsck baseline contains 561 diagnostics: 550 SNAPSHOT_STALE_CHANNEL, 10 ORPHAN_EVENT (all AUTO-RECOVER LINK type), and 1 STATUS_FORK_RESOLVED audit record across tickets store.
Scoped repair tool must safely remediate orphan events and stale-channel snapshots in batched, resumable operations with dry-run validation and push failure abort capability.

Live quiet-window execution successfully repaired all 10 orphan LINK events and 550 stale-channel snapshots across multiple batches, resulting in zero repairable diagnostics and retaining four intentional STATUS_FORK_RESOLVED audit records.
Repair commits and bundle artifacts must be verifiable with exact pre-window/post-window diagnostic manifests and disposable rollback capability to restore both pre-repair tip and FSCk findings.
